semester: 6th Semester (winter term start); 5th Semester (summer term start)

learning_outcomes.text: Students will know the fundamental information technology contexts and functionalities of embedded systems in motor vehicles.
Students will know the basic development process of embedded systems according to DIN-ISO 26262.

Students will understand the digital information flow from the source (sensor technology) via data processing (signal conditioning and control) to the information sink (actuators) in the motor vehicle at different OSI abstraction layers and be able to implement a prototype vehicle system as a model.
Students will possess the fundamental competence to diagnose errors in data transmission in the vehicle and derive solutions.
Students will be enabled to mediate as an interdisciplinary interface between mechanical development goals and electronic or information technology development goals.

syllabus_topics: Digital encoding and processing of information
System theory with modeling and control in relation to road vehicles
teaching_methods: Lecture with integrated exercises and laboratory experiments
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam. The grade's contribution to the final grade is weighted by credit points.
